relevance_note: Case report of one boy with genetically confirmed Danon disease: 'Genetic evaluation confirmed a diagnosis of Danon disease with a LAMP2 gene variant predicting a Y109ter truncation mutation.'
method_note: Read the whole paper by hand; values typed into a small Python builder script and every span checked verbatim by script. One in-scope person (single unnamed case-report patient, label 'patient'). The paper says the case was previously included in Maron et al. [9]. Not given rows: 'family members' whose genotyping was negative for LAMP2 (number and relationship not stated, so no individual can be identified); the Maron et al. patients ('five of seven Danon disease patients') and other literature figures, which are group-level only. Variant printed only as protein-level 'Y109ter' (no 'p.' prefix, no cDNA, no transcript); recorded as variant_original_string and protein_hgvs_as_stated as printed. Variant type left 'not reported': the paper calls it a 'truncation mutation', which has no exact enum value, and the class was not derived from the string. Inheritance left 'not reported' although the authors call it 'de novo': the paper says 'Genotyping of family members was negative', without stating that both parents were tested (rule 8); the statement is in parental_testing_statement. Zygosity not stated. Contradiction: the case text says 'no skeletal muscle disease was appreciated as the patient had 5/5 strength', while the Table 1 note says 'an elevated total creatine kinase level indicates skeletal myopathy'; both feature rows emitted and the checklist item 'proximal muscle weakness (skeletal myopathy)' set to 'not reported'. Heart failure checklist left 'not reported': the paper says only that the elevated BNP 'is consistent with heart failure' (interpretive); BNP elevation and LV dysfunction recorded as features. Atrioventricular block checklist left 'not reported': the paper reports 'prolonged PR interval' (recorded as a feature) but does not name AV block. Developmental delay checklist marked observed from 'speech delay' (a narrower delay). Reduced EF checklist observed from 'decreasing left ventricular ejection fraction (LVEF) over time' and 'progressive systolic and diastolic dysfunction'; no EF value is printed. Table 1 '-' cells are in the Average column (single value), not absence symbols. Laboratory values are ranges/averages over all visits; supplemental tables 1 and 2 were not available in the file. No stacked cells.

span: He was started on atenolol and underwent radiofrequency ablation (RFA) of two right posterior septal accessory connections.
He proved intolerant to beta-blockers due to asthma exacerbations and was transitioned to verapamil.
prompted implantation of an automatic implantable cardioverter-defibrillator (AICD)
He was also transitioned to dual-chambered pacing

He subsequently underwent synchronized cardioversion, but ultimately required an amiodarone drip to control his atrial fibrillation. He was transitioned to oral amiodarone, and revision of his AICD and cryoablation of the anomalous pathway were performed.
